text:
The diff does not match the ticket. The ticket asks for a /32 blackhole of 172.16.2.66, but the diff adds a null route for the entire 172.16.2.0/24 on PAO and PIT. That would blackhole all of customer 2, including c2-host (172.16.2.10), which the ticket says must stay reachable. The tests below target the stated intent and should fail on the diff as written.

```json
{"tests":[
{"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"present"},
{"t":"route","dev":"PAO","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"present"},
{"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"PAO","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns2","dst":"c2-host","svc":"icmp","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"tcp/443","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns2","dst":"c2-host","svc":"tcp/80","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"udp/53","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c1-host","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c3-host","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns2","dst":"c3-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"SEA","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"ATL","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"peer1","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"peer2","prefix":"172.16.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"peer1","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"absent"},
{"t":"route","dev":"peer2","prefix":"172.16.2.66/32","expect":"absent"},
{"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"ATL","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"adj","a":"PAO","b":"SEA","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"path","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"c2-host","via":"PIT","expect":true}
]}
```

The first two route tests check that the /32 blackhole is installed on both borders. The /24 route tests and the c2-host reachability tests check that the rest of the customer is not collateral damage. The remaining tests check that nothing else changes: other customers, return traffic from c2-host, adjacencies, and that the blackhole is not leaked to the peers.
